Announcement

We are the new owners of Glen Roy Cafe

We are refurbishing the cafe and planning to reopen with expanded hours, a refreshed menu and a stronger community focus.

We are excited to share that we are the new owners of Glen Roy Cafe in Roy Bridge.

We have plans we will share soon. We also plan to hold an open house for locals, giving people a chance to tell us what they would like from their village cafe.

Our aim is to make the cafe a practical asset for the community, with an expanded menu, regular hours, a small shop for staples like bread and milk, and a warm welcome.

A friendly village cafe in Roy Bridge serving coffee, tea, baking, sandwiches and useful local staples.
